== Summary ==
Portrait of [[Curtiss Murphy]], 400 × 400 px, the size the source served on 27 October 2026 (signed-in profile view). The signed-out public view of the same profile serves the same photograph at 200 × 200 px (see Source). Identification: Bill Bisco, 27 October 2026.

== Source ==
* [https://www.linkedin.com/in/curtissmurphy Curtiss Murphy], LinkedIn profile, read 27 October 2026 (profile photo). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027202123/https://swccg.com/snapshots/linkedin/curtissmurphy.html Internet Archive] (public profile view; LinkedIn blocks direct Wayback captures of the profile URL).
* Image file (200 × 200 rendition of this photograph): [https://media.licdn.com/dms/image/v2/D5603AQEPD-oAdeeAyg/profile-displayphoto-shrink_200_200/profile-displayphoto-shrink_200_200/0/1683862743430?e=2147483647&v=beta&t=SrAyn8W1GZyUlgLMxeQHLiPWGN5E4ylx478uTbV86sU profile-displayphoto-shrink_200_200], media.licdn.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027202239/https://media.licdn.com/dms/image/v2/D5603AQEPD-oAdeeAyg/profile-displayphoto-shrink_200_200/profile-displayphoto-shrink_200_200/0/1683862743430?e=2147483647&v=beta&t=SrAyn8W1GZyUlgLMxeQHLiPWGN5E4ylx478uTbV86sU Internet Archive] (SHA-256 f9c1ecf9e5cd562646bc964567f450e03485870565545dd0005f84ec9ae62ab7, the same bytes as the live 200 px file; this upload is the 400 px rendition of the same photograph).

== Fair use rationale ==
* '''Description:''' head-and-shoulders portrait of Curtiss Murphy.
* '''Purpose:''' identifies the subject of the article [[Curtiss Murphy]] and his row on [[Anagrams]] (the card [[Pucumir Thryss]]). No free photograph of him is known.
* '''Portion used:''' the whole image at the low resolution (400 × 400 px) the profile publishes; no larger copy was taken.
* '''Replaceability:''' a Decipher-era or tournament photograph would replace this one; none was found.
* '''Market effect:''' a small, non-commercial copy on a fan encyclopedia does not replace any commercial use of the photograph.
* '''Copyright:''' the photographer or Curtiss Murphy. Used under fair use for identification only.
